role: Operator narrow AI siege consumer correction

main.change: buildSiegeCityFromRuntime now passes the defending owner's real civ key from _menuCivIdByOwner/player.civType/aiOwnerCivMap, with null for missing data, and passes cityBuilt defensive building ids. Both initial and ongoing AI calls use this same builder.

siege.change: SiegeCity carries optional civKey and builtBuildingIds. cityDefenseBonus reuses cityWallDefenseBonusPercent plus civMatrixParam for obl_mur_proc and obl_obrona_miasta_proc. It exposes one structure multiplier. applyCityBonus accepts an explicit includeStructure flag; default false preserves the later resolveSiegeAttack path.

siege_ai.change: AI estimateDefenderStrength explicitly applies the structure multiplier once before calculating defender strength, so tier/stance inputs consume the defending city's civ matrix.

test.change: Extended the existing wiring harness with production siegeAi bundling and assertions for Grecy/neutral/Zulusi strength ordering, shared 200/288/160 structural percentages, unknown-civ neutral equivalence, one-application formula, and changed AI ratio input.

production_trace.defender_owner_source: city.ownerId; civ key resolved without Greece fallback from _menuCivIdByOwner, player.civType for owner 0, or aiOwnerCivMap
production_trace.no_double_boundary: applyCityBonus(includeStructure=false) remains the default for resolveSiegeAttack; only siegeAi passes true.

behavior_assertions.unknown_fallback: unknown/missing civ equals neutral matrix result
